finalText:
Perfect! All tests pass. The fix is complete. The issue was that `processOrder` was directly managing acquire/release without error handling. When a job failed (validation error), the connection was never released back to the pool, causing it to gradually exhaust over time. Adding the try-finally block ensures connections are always released, even when the job fails.

The pool can now safely recover from failed jobs, preventing the cascading 503 errors that started at 02:09:38 in the logs.
